prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Louis MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Dennis Ciot of Sansone Residential Collective
Mark Gellman’s team at eXp Realty
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every St. Louis home—the right fit depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available recent rankings and seller-side track records, **Dennis Ciot of Sansone Residential Collective** is one candidate to interview: HomeLight ranks him first in its St. Louis-area list using recent closed sales, sale-to-list performance, and review quality. **Mark Gellman’s team at eXp Realty** is another high-volume option, while **Dave Townsend** has a strong seller-focused record and reviews, particularly for homes in the south county area.

I’d interview two or three agents before choosing. Ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side sales in your neighborhood** and price range
- Their recommended list price, with comparable sales to support it
- A specific marketing and showing plan
- Who will handle your listing day to day
- Commission and any other fees, in writing

Rankings are useful starting points, not guarantees; local experience and a clear pricing strategy matter more than a citywide title. If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and property type, I can help narrow the shortlist.
